verdict.rationale: Typesense's own building-a-search-application guide explicitly includes a 'Faceting' step alongside 'Filtering results', and community commentary corroborates that Typesense 'handles faceted search already,' confirming built-in facet counts on filtered queries from a single API call. Missing for 10: detailed docs on range-based facets, multi-facet count aggregation mechanics, and independent hands-on verification of live counts specifically (only faceting/filtering existence is evidenced, not count-accuracy behavior).
